people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
translations.bsb: Paul stayed there two full years in his own rented house, welcoming all who came to visit him.
translations.kjv: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
translations.asv: And he abode two whole years in his own hired dwelling, and received all that went in unto him,
